evidence.title: Meta is back with Muse Glimmer: local, agentic, multimodal, and open source

summary: Meta introduces Muse Glimmer, an open-source AI model designed for local, agentic, and multimodal applications. The release highlights Meta's push for accessible and versatile AI tools.
title: Meta Unveils Muse Glimmer: A Local, Agentic, Multimodal Open-Source AI Model
